summary: Tessera Defense and Homeland Security Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 1 to its August 5, 2026 Share Purchase and Option Agreement with Mayers Ventures LLC, increasing its purchased interest in M.E.A. Testing Systems Ltd. from 10% to 15% on a fully diluted basis. Consideration is 195,000 Tessera common shares, about 4.5% of outstanding stock, representing 1,300,000 pre-reverse-split shares plus 65,000 additional shares, issued at closing. A prior $50,000 cash payment was replaced by an advance under a new 12% unsecured $475,000 convertible loan facility. The transaction closed September 16, 2026, alongside a Technology License Agreement. Watchers should monitor NYSE American listing authorization for the additional shares and dilution/overhang risk.
